## Motivation

Agent skills and rules cite moved files, deleted guard tests, and retired runtime-context APIs. These stale references misdirect agents and overstate which contracts CI enforces. Update the guidance to match the current implementation and surviving checks.

## Modifications

- Correct the parser, scheduler-profiler, JIT compile-package, and diffusion complex-rope test paths; remove the deleted profile-v2 test reference.
- Distinguish the surviving launch-path and server-info transport checks from review-only coverage. Remove deleted mutation/module-state guards and obsolete read-check baselines.
- Describe resolution through `ServerArgs.resolve_once()` and `resolving_view(server_args)`, including the strict write guard after resolving a dummy record.
- Describe parallel reads as scoped override, permanent stamp, then published leaf. Ranks are stamped at publication; distributed initialization installs group handles and validates widths. Derived DCP width and enablement remain configuration-backed unless explicitly overridden.
- Remove the retired `ParallelState` guidance and update the unit-test admission example.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (documentation only). Applicable pre-commit hooks, whitespace checks, and focused source-consistency checks passed. The referenced runtime-context test filenames and replacement paths were verified against the source. No runtime or accelerator tests were run for this documentation update.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A (documentation only).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (N/A, docs only)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

issue_comments.body:
One more stale passage in `.agents/skills/sglang-runtime-context/SKILL.md` that this PR could pick up, since it already edits the file: the `get_parallel()` text still describes the parallel record #40343 retired.

- The table row for `parallel` and the "`get_parallel()`: one spelling per name" section say ranks and group handles are `@property` read-through over the canonical getters. At current `main`, `ParallelContext._read` (`python/sglang/srt/runtime_context.py`) answers every name in one order: a scoped override, then a permanent stamp (ranks are stamped at `publish`, group handles at distributed init), then the published `parallel` leaf.
- The paragraph starting "A third surface carries the same names: `ParallelState` (`self.ps` / `mr.ps`)" describes a class that no longer exists at `main`; it can be removed.

Addressed the review and follow-up in e06f0a4f8b:

- Corrected the remaining test coverage descriptions and removed references to deleted guards and retired baselines.
- Updated resolution guidance to `ServerArgs.resolve_once()` and `resolving_view(server_args)`, including the strict guard for resolved dummy records.
- Updated `get_parallel()` to scoped override → permanent stamp → published leaf, removed the retired `ParallelState` paragraph, and aligned the DCP guidance.
- Updated the unit-test admission example and PR title as suggested.

Merged current `main` in bb2b511e44; the merge completed cleanly. Pre-commit passed for the edited files, and all referenced test filenames in the runtime-context skill were verified against `main`.

The current red checks are CI gates, not test failures: [AMD](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39217305154), [AMD Extra](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39217305063), and [Extra](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39217305191) all report `Missing required label 'run-ci'`. Their finish jobs fail as a consequence, and the test jobs are skipped. The Rust builds are still running.
